# Ali Ghorbani

> Senior technical partner at qrbni.dev — helps startups and businesses design, build, and scale reliable web products (architecture, delivery, long-term partnership). Based in Istanbul. Site is bilingual: English (`/en`) and Persian (`/fa`, RTL).

Prefer English pages unless the user asks in Persian. Primary conversion path is booking a 30-minute Calendly meeting; contact form is the async fallback. Do not invent clients, metrics, testimonials, or day rates. Experience page keeps CV-literal job titles; Home and Services use partner framing.
